entries.title: Psalms 75:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. Set to "Do Not Destroy." A Psalm of Asaph. A Song.>> We give thanks to You, O God, we give thanks! For Your wondrous works declare [that] Your name is near.

entries.title: Psalms 75:2
segments: "When I choose the proper time, I will judge uprightly.

entries.title: Psalms 75:3
segments: The earth and all its inhabitants are dissolved; I set up its pillars firmly. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 75:4
segments: 'I said to the boastful, 'Do not deal boastfully,' And to the wicked, 'Do not lift up the horn.

entries.title: Psalms 75:5
segments: Do not lift up your horn on high; Do [not] speak with a stiff neck.'"

entries.title: Psalms 75:6
segments: ¶For exaltation [comes] neither from the east Nor from the west nor from the south.

entries.title: Psalms 75:7
segments: But God [is] the Judge: He puts down one, And exalts another.

entries.title: Psalms 75:8
segments: For in the hand of the LORD [there is] a cup, And the wine is red; It is fully mixed, and He pours it out; Surely its dregs shall all the wicked of the earth Drain [and] drink down.

entries.title: Psalms 75:9
segments: But I will declare forever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 75:10
segments: 'All the horns of the wicked I will also cut off, [But] the horns of the righteous shall be exalted."
